deals.deal: $0 Delivery Fee on Orders of $10+ (Sarku Rewards)
deals.desc: Sarku Rewards members (free to join) get $0 delivery on orders of $10 or more when ordering through the Sarku app or website through November 8.

deals.deal: Buy One Get One Free Footlong for Sub Club Members
deals.desc: October 27 through November 8: every current or new Sub Club member (free account) gets a free Footlong of equal or lesser price with any Footlong bought in the Subway app or on subway.com. The offer sits in the app wallet automatically; one per order, add-ons extra, excludes Fresh Fit, 5 Meat Italian and Big Hot Pastrami. Choose turkey or veggie for a healthier pick. Stated in Subway's own October 21 newsroom release.

deals.deal: $7 Regular Ramen with Code RAMEN7
deals.desc: Any regular-sized ramen bowl for $7 through November 15: enter code RAMEN7 at noodles.com checkout or give the code at the counter. Open to everyone, no account needed; one per order, not on third-party delivery or catering, participating locations, while the chain's redemption cap lasts. The code and its terms are on Noodles' own offers terms page.

deals.deal: Tropic Fan Fest: Free 24 oz Smoothie with Any Bowl or Food Purchase, Every Day
deals.desc: November 2 through 8: Tropic Rewards members (free account) get a free 24 oz smoothie with any Tropic Bowl or food item, once a day, all week. Add the food and a smoothie to an app or tropicalsmoothiecafe.com order and tap Apply on the Tropic Fan Fest reward, or scan the app in the cafe; the credit covers the lowest-priced 24 oz smoothie. Excludes Toasted Snack Rolls, the Sunshine Smoothie, sides, sweets and kids' items; participating cafes.

deals.deal: Free Delivery on Every Order Through the End of 2026
deals.desc: Through the end of 2026, delivery orders placed on mezeh.com or in the Mezeh app carry no delivery fee, for anyone, no code or account needed. Build-your-own bowls, wraps and family packs all qualify. Stated on Mezeh's own homepage.
deals.region: VA, MD, DC, PA, NC, SC, GA, FL & TX

deals.deal: $5 Friday: Fresh Sushi Rolls for $5
deals.desc: Every Friday, Safeway's $5 Friday lineup includes fresh sushi rolls from the in-store counter for $5 (regularly $8 to $10), alongside other prepared-food deals like an 8-piece chicken bag. Check the weekly ad for your division; a free Safeway for U account may be needed for the promo price.

deals.deal: $6 Sushi Friday: California, Vegetable, Spicy Tuna and Spicy Salmon Rolls
deals.desc: Every Friday, Harris Teeter's Zenshi sushi counters sell four rolls for $6 each: California, Vegetable, Spicy Tuna and Spicy Salmon (regularly about $9.49 to $10.49). In store, while supplies last; the free VIC card may be needed for the promo price. Seen in store October 2, 2026.

deals.deal: Sushi Friday: Buy One Nori Roll, Get One 50% Off
deals.desc: Every Friday at participating Hy-Vee stores, buy one regular Nori Sushi roll and get a second at half price. Store-run promotion: participation varies, no card or app needed.

deals.deal: Sub of the Week: $2 Off This Week's Featured Whole Sub
deals.desc: Every week Publix takes $2 off one featured whole deli sub (a Boar's Head turkey sub or the Publix Deli Ultimate Sub, for example, about $8.99 instead of $10.99), fully customizable at the counter, online or in the app. The featured sub changes with the weekly ad; the deli's weekly specials page lists it.

deals.deal: $9.99 Pita Meal Deal
deals.desc: Naf Naf Grill's value menu: a full pita meal for $9.99, in store and in the app, every day at participating locations.

deals.deal: $5 Off Two Regular Rice Bowls with Code CE41FLDF
deals.desc: Standing coupon on Yoshinoya's own coupons page: add two regular rice bowls (chicken, beef or veggie) in-store, online or in the app and apply code CE41FLDF at checkout for $5 off; no account needed. Not valid on ribeye, salmon or limited-time items; participating locations. The same page lists $5 off two large bowls (code CRSA6MCE), $5 off two combo bowls (C6Z88J4A) and 20% off $20 (C9M7P979), 25% off $25 (C3FBHN3D) or 30% off $30 (up to $10 off).

deals.deal: Double Fire Deal: Two Charbroiled Chicken or Tofu Bowls with Two Add-Ons for $20
deals.desc: Limited time: two charbroiled chicken or tofu rice bowls plus two add-ons for $20 together, at participating locations, no account or code needed. Flame Broiler bowls are usually about $11 to $12 each before add-ons. Stated on Flame Broiler's own homepage.

deals.deal: National Nacho Day: $7 Chicken Nachos with Code NACHODAY
deals.desc: Friday, November 6 only: an adult-size Create Your Own Nachos with Flame-Grilled Adobo Chicken or the new Chicken Tinga for $7. Use promo code NACHODAY at online or app checkout, or mention the promo in the restaurant; no account needed. One per customer, not valid on delivery or catering, cannot be combined with Rewards wallet items; participating U.S. and Puerto Rico locations. The code is printed on qdoba.com's homepage.

deals.deal: $1 Bottomless Fountain Drinks for PERi-Perks Members
deals.desc: PERi-Perks members (free account) can add a bottomless fountain drink to any meal for $1 instead of the usual $3.99, in app, online or in-restaurant.
deals.region: DC, MD, VA, IL, TX & GA

deals.deal: 2 for $12 Culinary Classics Entrees for Noodles Rewards Members
deals.desc: Friday, November 6 through Tuesday, November 10: two regular-size Culinary Classics entrees (Creamy Cheddar Mac & Cheese, Baked Mac, Gochujang Carbonara Ramen and the rest of the line) for $12 together, for Noodles Rewards members (free account). Order signed in on noodles.com or in the app and apply the reward on the cart screen; one redemption per member during the promotion. Not valid on third-party delivery, call-in or catering orders; participating locations. Stated on Noodles' own offers terms page.

deals.deal: National Nacho Day: $5.99 Nachos Entree
deals.desc: Friday, November 6: a $5.99 Nachos entree in the restaurant for anyone who mentions the offer at checkout, no account needed. Moe Rewards members (free account) also get $5.99 Nachos entrees online or in the app from November 6 through Sunday, November 8 by applying the reward at checkout. Excludes add-ons, extras and premium proteins; single use; participating locations; not valid with other offers or third-party delivery. Stated on Moe's own offers page.

deals.deal: Kids Eat Free: Free Chicken or Tofu Mini Bowl with Each Full-Price Entree
deals.desc: Every day: one free kids Chicken or Tofu Mini Bowl with the purchase of any full-price entree, weekdays after 4 PM and all day Saturday and Sunday, at all WaBa Grill locations. No account or coupon needed. Stated in WaBa Grill's own press release and on its homepage.
deals.expires: Weekdays after 4 PM, all day weekends

deals.deal: Free Upsize Friday: 32 oz Smoothie for the Price of a 20 oz
deals.desc: Every Friday, Healthy Rewards members (free account required) get a 32 oz smoothie for the price of a 20 oz when they order in the Smoothie King app, at participating locations. Rewards cannot be redeemed on these orders.

deals.deal: 15% off Meals To Go orders of $25 or more
deals.desc: Hy-Vee Meals To Go prepared meal orders of $25+ get 15% off, announced by email on 2026-11-05; free Hy-Vee PERKS account may be required for savings tracking.

deals.deal: $5 Core and $7 Premium Pizzas After 5 PM on Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays
deals.desc: Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays after 5 PM: Double Cheese or Pepperoni pizzas for $5 and Meaty, Supreme, Veggie or BBQ Chicken and Jalapeno pizzas for $7, in-store or online, no account needed. Select locations while supplies last; excludes add-ons, kids' pizzas and gluten-free crust; not valid with other offers or third-party delivery. Stated on Schlotzsky's own offers page.
deals.expires: Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays after 5 PM
